depiction.primary_object: outlined cloud with top contour curving inward
modifiers: downward-pointing arrow inside the cloud formed from the top line
depiction.composition: single continuous-line style glyph centered in frame

readings.meaning: cloud download / fetch from cloud storage
export data archive from online service

ambiguity: Because the arrow points down into the center of the cloud rather than out below the bottom edge, a few viewers might briefly read it as importing into the cloud, though the downward arrow universally cues download.

modifier_semantics.meaning: download, retrieve locally, pull, or save offline

task_intents: pull backup archive to local drive
save media for offline travel use

fetch shared assets from team drive
sync remote repository to local machine

reasoning: A cloud with a downward arrow is the universal symbol for downloading from the cloud, exporting online archives, or saving content for offline access. These are frequent, concrete to-do items across tech, finance, admin, and travel prep. It only risks minor confusion with cloud upload or plain cloud storage icons at tiny sizes.
